01 / QUALITY ENGINEERING

Start with risk and evidence

Quality Assurance prevents defects through clear requirements, test planning, test strategy, and feedback loops. Software Testing discovers information through checks. Link each requirement to acceptance criteria, tests, and defects through test traceability; record reproducible evidence in defect tracking and test reporting tools such as Allure.

Unit Testing validates small units; Integration Testing validates boundaries; End-to-End Testing validates critical journeys. Use Regression Testing after change, Exploratory Testing for discovery, and Acceptance Testing for business outcomes. See automation for how to make repeatable checks fast.

Risk: customer is charged twice
Checks: disable Pay + idempotency key + one database record
Evidence: request ID, API response, audit log

02 / TEST AUTOMATION

Automate behavior, not clicks

Playwright and browser automation are strongest when they verify user-visible outcomes with semantic locators. A Page Object Model centralizes interaction details; Test Fixtures provide isolated state and dependencies; Test Data Management prevents parallel tests from colliding. BDD and Cucumber can express business scenarios when collaboration benefits from executable examples.

test('sign in', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.getByLabel('Email').fill('qa@example.test');
  await page.getByRole('button', {name:'Sign in'}).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading')).toContainText('Dashboard');
});

Use Network Interception to make external failures deterministic, but retain integrated coverage. Pair Visual Regression Testing with review, and include keyboard, semantic, and contrast checks in Accessibility Testing. The fastest stable suite uses API tests for rules and a small UI layer for journeys.

03 / SOFTWARE ENGINEERING

Build explicit contracts

HTML provides semantic structure, CSS handles presentation, and Responsive Web Design adapts interfaces. JavaScript runs in browsers and Node.js; TypeScript adds static contracts. Python is productive for automation, data, and services. React builds components; Express.js, FastAPI, and Gradio expose applications.

type Order = { id: string; total: number };
function isOrder(x: unknown): x is Order {
  return typeof x === 'object' && x !== null;
}

Use unknown for external input, then validate before use. In Python, Pydantic does the same at runtime. This boundary rule directly supports API contracts and structured AI outputs.

04 / APIS AND DATA

Validate semantics, not just status codes

REST APIs use HTTP methods: GET reads, POST creates, PUT replaces, PATCH partially updates. API Testing validates status, headers, data, errors, authorization, idempotency, and timeouts. API Contract Testing uses JSON and JSON Schema to protect consumers. Postman helps explore; automated API integration makes examples repeatable.

const response = await request.get('/api/orders/o-1');
expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
expect(await response.json()).toMatchObject({id:'o-1'});

SQL queries relational stores: PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite. Redis is useful for cache and short-lived state. Authenticate Webhooks, acknowledge quickly, and process them idempotently. These contracts feed reliable delivery.

05 / DELIVERY AND INFRASTRUCTURE

Ship small, repeatable changes

Git records history and GitHub supports collaboration. CI/CD runs verification before delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins. A good quality gate is risk-based: tests, contracts, security, health checks, and rollback readiness.

name: Verify
on: [pull_request]
jobs: { test: { runs-on: ubuntu-latest, steps: [{run: 'python scripts/verify.py'}] } }

Docker packages runtime dependencies; Docker Compose models local multi-service systems. Linux, DevOps, Cloud Deployment, Environment Variables, and Secrets Management make software operable. A Reverse Proxy such as Caddy routes traffic and terminates TLS; monitor it through observability.

06 / AI AUTOMATION

Bound agents with schemas and approvals

Large Language Models generate likely text, not guaranteed truth. Prompt Engineering defines goals and constraints. Use Structured Outputs, Tool Calling, and Function Calling with schema validation before executing an action. Put Human-in-the-Loop Systems before consequential actions.

{ "name":"create_ticket", "parameters": {"type":"object", "required":["title"]} }

RAG retrieves relevant sources before generation. Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes access to tools, resources, and prompts; MCP Server Development should apply least privilege. n8n, LangGraph, LangChain, and CrewAI orchestrate workflows. Evaluate traces with LangSmith; protect against prompt injection through AI Safety controls.

07 / OPERATIONS AND IOT

Operate what you build

Observability joins Logging, metrics, and traces. Alerting must be actionable and tied to impact. Reliability Engineering uses service objectives, error budgets, capacity, and controlled change. During Incident Management, stabilize, communicate, preserve evidence, then conduct Root Cause Analysis using Runbooks and systematic Troubleshooting.

logger.info('payment_completed', {orderId, requestId, durationMs});

IoT connects Sensors and hardware to automation. MQTT uses publish/subscribe topics. Home Assistant, Tuya, and Home Automation combine devices safely. Store telemetry as Time-Series Data and make it useful through Dashboard Design.

08 / DATA PRACTICE

Make information trustworthy

Data Quality means accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, and uniqueness. Data Validation enforces those expectations at boundaries. ETL, Data Pipelines, and Data Processing require lineage, retries, ownership, and monitoring. Data Analysis asks transparent questions; Data Visualization communicates the answer; Data Documentation explains fields, owners, and limitations.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE email IS NULL;
